Date: 2028-07-20T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Partnership enablement — proposal to run a joint SI bootcamp

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks for the intro via the partner portal last week. I'm Alyssa, Head of Delivery at EdgeWorks Consulting — we run a 12‑person systems integrator practice focused on enterprise search and conversational assistants. We've been piloting Redwood in two POCs and want to formalize a Solutions Integrator partnership so our delivery teams can ship Redwood-enabled products faster.

High-level asks: 
- A 2-week technical onboarding for 6 SEs + 2 PMs (hands-on labs + sample prompt sets)
- Access to a partner sandbox with model variants suitable for finance/legal workloads (or guidance on equivalent hosted configs)
- A mutual action plan and intake checklist so we can map customer use cases to Redwood features (routing, caching, quantization profiles)

Can we schedule a 30–45 minute sync next week to scope this? Ben (cc) is our Practice Lead and will own the internal training logistics.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering.

— Alyssa Turner
Head of Delivery, EdgeWorks Consulting

Hi Alyssa — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the clear ask. I'm the partner enablement lead covering consultancies and SI programs. 

Quick thoughts / proposed next steps: 
1) Kickoff call: 30–45m next Tue/Wed to align scope, timeline, and success metrics (can you share preferred slots?)
2) Mutual Action Plan (MAP): We'll draft a MAP covering pre-kickoff checklist, training syllabus, environment access, and a 60/90-day joint delivery play. Marissa (cc) owns the MAP template and delivery enablement.
3) Sandbox & compliance: Soojin (cc) will weigh in on sandbox profiles and any data-handling constraints for finance/legal POCs.
4) Materials: we have a hands‑on lab, sample prompt library, and a partner lab environment. If you can send 1–2 sample customer scenarios we'll customize the labs.

I've penciled in Wed 2028-07-26 at 10:00 PT for a kickoff — does that work for you and Ben? If not, propose 2 alternative times.

I'll prepare a short MAP draft and attach baseline agenda + a checklist for what we need from you.

Best,
Nikhil

Thanks, team. Adding a more concrete enablement plan so Alyssa has something to review ahead of the kickoff. See attached.

Executive summary:
- Sprint length: 2 weeks (3 half‑days hands‑on + 2 full‑day workshops + 1 validation day)
- Attendees: 6 SEs, 2 PMs, 1 Partner ops lead
- Outcomes: partner‑certified lab delivery, three reference playbooks (search, knowledge base Q&A, secure docs assistant), sample prompt sets, and an internal enablement recording.

Core modules (short):
1) Redwood fundamentals & product map — APIs, routing, and model variants (90m)
2) High‑throughput serving patterns — batching, KV caching, quantization tradeoffs (120m lab)
3) Secure deployment patterns — Private/VPC primer and audit logs (90m)
4) Practical delivery labs — build a mini POC with prefix caching + rollout policy (180m)

Pre-work (what we need from EdgeWorks):
- Two example customer use cases with expected volume and latency goals
- Any redlines/controls required by customers (e.g., data residency, key management)
- Contact for internal training logistics and an engineer who will attend as a trainer shadow

Attached: SI-enablement-sprint-outline.pdf, sample-training-agenda.xlsx

Will follow up with the MAP doc before the call.

— Marissa Cole
Sr. Partner Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: sample-training-agenda.xlsx (workbook)
